records.title: Rider-Waite-Smith tarot card artwork, original 1909 edition
records.scope: The original 1909 card illustrations only. This record does not cover later scans, photographs, restorations, recolorings, borders, typography, card backs, packaging, guidebooks, trademarks, or modern editions.

jurisdictionNotes.unitedStates: The U.S. Copyright Office states that works published in the United States before January 1, 1931 are in the public domain as of 2026. A candidate file must still be verified as a faithful reproduction of the original work and checked for separate rights.
jurisdictionNotes.unitedKingdom: Official UK guidance gives the usual term for artistic works as 70 years after the author's death. Older works and particular source reproductions can require additional analysis.
jurisdictionNotes.europeanUnion: Directive 2006/116/EC generally sets life plus 70 years for literary and artistic works. Territory-specific rules, source-file rights, and the intended App Store storefronts must be reviewed before release.

officialReferences.title: Directive 2006/116/EC on the term of protection of copyright and related rights

prohibitedAssumptions: A modern edition is safe because it depicts the original RWS composition.
A file marked public domain by one uploader is cleared for every intended storefront.
A scan, photograph, restoration, recoloring, crop, border, or card back has no separate rights.
The Rider-Waite-Smith name, packaging, or commercial presentation is cleared by the age of the original illustrations.
